clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity's Temple of the Damned, Carendin Halgar guides Forsaken warlocks toward binding a succubus. Godrick Farsan knows how to lure one from the Twisting Nether with the hearts of pure, loving mortals.

Carendin Halgar teaches that a succubus must be enticed across the threshold, not summoned by command. The demon hungers to ruin virtue and consume mortal essence. To draw it forth, you offer the hearts of genuinely virtuous, loving men as bait. Halgar sends you to Godrick Farsan, who knows where such rare quarry can be found.

Deeper in the Temple of the Damned, Godrick Farsan helps Carendin prepare for demonic binding. Farsan has lost his physical eyesight, but says this grants him a deeper sight. He claims to perceive spiritual currents and distant souls with uncanny clarity, and can guide you to the pure hearts needed to draw out the demon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A succubus is a devourer of souls, destroyer of hearts, tempter of men. A creature of profound evil and of singular mind.
It cannot be brought into our world without a stimulus.

Thus we use its own strength against it. With the hearts of good men, pure men, loving men, the succubus will be unable to resist, and will cross into our world. Then you can dominate it, and make it your own.
Speak with my assistant, Godrick Farsan, within the Temple. He will help you find your bait.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You were sent by Carendin? Friend, then.
Do not think light of me because my sight is gone. I see things that lie behind now, with clarity I had never known. What I once thought a curse, is now a boon.
